Blue light pooling on the sidewalk
Your shadow stretched out long
You look like you've been waiting for a song that won't come on
There's a flicker in the storefront, buzzin' soft in half-dead glow
And I'm three blocks from anywhere, but I'm exactly where I go

Feel the bass kick through the gray
Head tilted, you're already late
For a moment that can't hold its shape
I'm reaching for the static on the wave
Neon bleeding through the dark
A feeling with no address
You'll be in your room by the morning
But right now, city holds us

Neon light in through the dark
I have smiled and a spark
If this is real or just a glow
Catch it before it goes
I keep thinking about the Tuesday after them

Still like thirst won't in the well
I had this pause heavy in my chest
Maybe we should have put it to the test

She is strange now looking back
Recasts the hues
All the quiet things we left unsaid to you
If i just say what's heavy in my chest

We were buried to the tears
Just a silence now
And the quiet grew
